title: The boy who cried wolf.
lines: In a little village in the mountains lives a boy.
Every day he takes the sheep up the hill.
All day long just sheep and grass.
He runs to the edge of the hill.
He shouts as loud as he can.
In the village people hear it.
They walk back to the village.
The next day Peter is bored again.
Again the people run up the hill.
Now the people are very angry.
Then, one evening, Peter sees something moving among the trees.
The wolf creeps towards the sheep.
Peter runs to the edge of the hill.
In the village people hear it.
But they look at each other.
There's Peter with his jokes again, they say.
We won't fall for it anymore.
The wolf chases the sheep down the hill.
Luckily the old shepherd comes by.
The wolf gets a fright and runs into the forest.
It takes all night to find them all again.
The old shepherd puts a hand on his shoulder.
When you lie, nobody believes you anymore.
Not even when you tell the truth.
From that day on he never lies again.
And slowly people start to believe him again.
